description:
Rendering alone cannot turn a 750-character finding paragraph into problem, impact and fix. Proposal section 8.7: start with the brief-only option (ask the reviewer to write `detail` as short `Problem:`, `Impact:`, `Fix:` paragraphs and titles ≤80 chars; the renderer bolds the labels when present and falls back otherwise; gate reviews get a one-sentence lead before the mandatory bypass analysis, which stays). A schema change (optional impact/fix/evidence keys) is the alternative.
Decision gates: (1) owner chooses brief-only or schema; (2) because this changes reviewer behaviour, it ships only through the review-eval gate, which needs live model runs: owner approval of the eval spend is required before any run, and the eval score rule is currently inactive (no authenticated baseline; see theseus-trusted-candidate-evaluator-20261109).
Not part of the format delivery batch; deferred until both gates are decided.
